description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyAPI class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. The class provides REST API endpoints for managing job vacancies, including CRUD operations, validation rules, and parameter handling. It uses various traits and external models related to vacancies, job titles, and employees, indicating it is central to vacancy management in the recruitment module.

classes.name: VacancyAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing job vacancies in the recruitment module, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting vacancy records, with validation and access control.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a specific vacancy by ID and returns its detailed model.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all vacancies with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new vacancy record based on request parameters.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Populates a Vacancy object with data from the request, including validation for active job titles and employees.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll endpoint.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the model class to use for listing based on request params.

methods.name: getModelClassParamRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for the model class parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing vacancy record based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update endpoint.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules for create and update request bodies.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes vacancies by IDs provided in the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete endpoint.
